{"reason":"Add the >=0.7 confidence gate and tighten change/exposure thresholds to >0.4 and >1,000,000. Each of eight listed false-arbitration rows violates at least one gate, so this should reduce the 0.714 false-arbitration rate while retaining enough of the eight true positives to keep recall >=0.8.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.4)
       (> inventory-exposure 1000000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
